paragraphs: Chapter 981
Episode 243. The Red King's Surprise Attack (1)
Midworld.
After the Meisil battle, the Red Plutonian tribe had been continuously exploring Midworld.
Leaving only a minimum of defensive forces in the four cities, including Pivilok, they began to search for the 'Land of God.'
Pivil, Patil, Rital, Vesel.
Four air fortresses were fully operational, excluding the one usurped by Elona. Pivil and Patil had some damages from the battle, but they had already been repaired.
'If it weren't for the Shimat brethren, our Red Plutonian tribe would have met a miserable end.'
Right after Elona attacked Usrok, only Shimat insisted on attacking the Royal Palace, risking everything.
Thanks to that, the Red Plutonian tribe regained part of its former glory and escaped the control of the royal family.
The process involved the variable of the Vamel Alliance and the Sun Religion, but it was a great success.
'And the Shimat brethren... might be our god. I often felt an unknowable dignity when Shimat brethren spoke.'
With this operation, Shimat had already received recognition equivalent to the Great Warrior from all his brethren.
And Baccarun and Shimat's original superior, Rakiman, were particularly feeling something more peculiar from him.
An intuition that his words should not be contradicted.
"Baccarun brother! We just received contact from Vesel exploring Nilot. They claim to have found the sword and seal of the god brother near the royal family's hideout suspected in Nilot...!"
The Red Plutonian god's sword and seal.
Those two things were the basis on which the Red Plutonian first believed in the royal family's claims.
Knowing where your god is.
"Send it at once, tell them."
"Red Plutonian!"
"And, summon the Shimat brethren in Patil."
"Understood."
An artifact in the shape of a disc was placed in the middle of the command center.
The artifact displayed a window for video communication or was used to send objects like now.
A red energy rose above the artifact, and a small dimensional gate opened.
From inside the gate, a sword and a gold belt came out, and the watching Red Plutonian all knelt on one knee.
"The Red King's sword and seal... indeed, they are the god brother's belongings!"
Many Red Plutonian were shedding tears.
They behaved like believers who had finally found the lost traces of a deity.
Baccarun called Shimat because he thought he might react to the sword and seal.
As he had foreseen, Shimat exuded an atmosphere different from usual as soon as he entered the Pivil's ship.
Even the mid-level warriors and ordinary soldiers noticed Shimat's change.
Therefore, they did not stop Shimat as he strode towards the artifact and touched the sword and seal.
As soon as he held the sword, memories that he had forgotten started to flood into Shimat's mind like flowing water.
Who he was, why he had hidden his traces before the crowning and became 'Shimat'.
And what he must do now.
"Indeed, my choice was not wrong."
Shimat spoke, looking around.
Those who were kneeling were now bowing to Shimat.
Only the communication officers were seated, informing all fortresses and fleets that the god had returned.
The Red King of the Sky had returned.
As soon as the message was delivered, massive dimensional gates opened all around Pivil.
All the air fortresses and fleets were rushing to pay homage to the returned god.
"God... God brother, I always believed you would return. You were so close..."
Baccarun spoke, kissing Shimat's hand. Then Baccarun personally handed Shimat the sword and belt.
Unlike the Blue Plutonian tribe, for the Red Plutonian tribe, the god is a representative of the Sun God and the subject of faith.
For them, the god meant more than just the strongest warrior or supreme commander.
"Baccarun, while I was Shimat, you always made the right decisions. You have greatly supported me."
"I apologize for not doing better."
"Go, God brother...! This Rakiman was foolish and did not recognize you."
Rakiman had made several disappointing choices while commanding Shimat.
Shimat recalled the mistakes he had made and chuckled.
"You can do well from now on. In the first place, I changed my appearance and identity without telling you all, so I won't blame you."
The Great Warriors of the Red Plutonian tribe are connected to the fortress, that is, the air fortresses.
They could use that power for a battle transformation called 'fortress transformation,' and they could use the unique abilities bestowed by the god on each fortress.
And the god, unlike the Great Warriors, is connected to the sword.
The sword 'Tetalon,' forged from a fragment of the Sun God's physical body, emitted a red light. That energy absorbed into Shimat, restoring him to his true form.
His hair became a shade redder and longer, and the runes symbolizing the god floated up on his body.
Eyes burning like torches, a dense and thick glow in the pupils.
Even the unique dark sky of the middle world outside the bridge was all tinged red. It seemed as if the entire middle world was resonating with the manifested power of Tushin.
"Why I hid my tracks and stayed with you as Shimat, I'll explain in detail later. For now, we must find my land, Critil."
Critil.
The ancient capital of the Red Clan, the land of Tushin.
At that place, the Red Clan's most formidable airborne fortress was hidden.
Ever since the Red Clan began to actively operate, they had been trying to find that place. However, unlike the other sealed cities, Critil was buried in a completely different area.
The Royal Family was the only one expected to know its location.
Shimat began to input coordinates directly onto the artifact.
"Tushin Brother, this place is..."
Bakarun said, looking at the coordinates.
The coordinates pointed to the ground.
It could be called underground by ordinary ground standards, but it wasn't even the middle world by the standard of 'Boundary of Ameris'.
The capital of Zipfel, Drakka.
Critil was hidden beneath it.
"Yes, it's outside the boundary. And under the capital of Zipfel. I didn't expect this when I first chose the location, but it seems the Sun God has looked after us..."
Since the appearance of Zipfel in human history, Drakka had never once not been their land.
Furthermore, even before the emergence of Zipfel, the land where Drakka was located was the greatest reward given to those who held power in that era.
Critil was located within the crust of that land.
Like most other regions, Drakka had never been exposed to such a powerful shock that the crust would crumble.
Hence, no one had found Critil until now.
Critil was literally no different from an intact legacy of an ancient civilization beneath the ground.
"My brothers, Critil was never sealed by the great snake. In Critil, the spoils we took from that era remain intact, and the powerful weapons to strangle our enemies are also in good condition."
The eyes of the Red Clan widened.
Just a moment ago, they too had believed that Critil must naturally exist somewhere in the middle world or underground.
"Then, can't we attack the heart of Zipfel at any time...!?"
"Yes, Bekios Brother. But Drakka can't be considered the heart of Zipfel. Symbolically, it is certainly the capital of the entire Lutero Federation, but their real core is the Tower of Stories."
Having said that, Shimat took a moment to recall information about the Tower of Stories.
"The power to manipulate history... Such foolish people. They believe they can do something that even the Sun God couldn't do. If it were possible, why didn't the Sun God alter history before dying?"
Shimat directed the coordinates, and the aerial fortresses were opening portals.
"It's time to set foot on the homeland and give those arrogant humans a blow. Move!"
"Red Plutonian!"
The aerial fortresses and the fleet began to enter the portals.
Shortly after, the Red Plutonian could reach the capital Kritel. Indeed, Kritel was preserved in its ancient form, just as Shimat had said.
"Kritel!"
For a period longer than human history, not even dust had settled in Kritel. The city was wrapped in a crystal-like transparent shield, glimmering brightly.
The Red Plutonian disembarked from the fleet and followed Shimat to explore the city firsthand.
Their preserved brethren, lying in maintenance devices, seemed ready to awaken at a drop of blood. Beside them, countless jars filled with the blood of the Chongmyeong and Majok were placed.
With that blood, the city could be revived in an instant.
The Red Plutonian couldn't contain their swelling hearts and yelled repeatedly.
"It's too early to rejoice, my brethren. Now I will open a blood festival in Drakka. All my brethren will enjoy it to their heart's content."
As Eltiot said, Shimat was not just a figure with the power of creation.
His greatest strengths were leadership, strategy, and bold decision-making.

"By now, Elona Zipfel will be in the Tower of Tales, analyzing the stolen Woo. The capital will be full of Kelliark and scum. Even if Elona is on standby, it doesn't matter. If the four aerial fortresses and Kritel ambush her all at once, even that monster will have to flee."
Even though Usrok had been quickly taken by Elona's surprise attack, the Red Plutonian did not doubt Shimat's words.
If Usrok had been fully prepared for Elona, they wouldn't have been so terribly defeated.
The current power of the Red Plutonian fleet was even greater than the Temple of Hyungshin's Ram.
Soon, Shimat sat on the jade throne in Kritel's inner sanctum.
As he infused energy into the artifact in front of the throne, the whole city began to engage in battle mode.
As the power source of the aerial fortress, 'Kri', activated, the whole land and sky began to vibrate.
"Once we ascend to the main cannon's range, we will bombard them from beneath the ground and turn their city into ashes. Today, Drakka will become the land of our Red Plutonian."
"Red Plutonian!"
As the Red Plutonian began to move in unison, Shimat grinned and added,
"And Eltiot and Ameris, my old friends, and true Runcandel will know that I have returned. I wonder what their faces will look like."
